# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Universal SSR focus programme.
COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_starting_UKR = {
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_plan
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_plan_revised
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_plan_republican
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_plan_settlement_rewarded } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_plan_republican }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_industrial_conversion_rewarded } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_enterprise_accounts_rewarded } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_plan_revised }
	else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_plan }
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_patronage
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_professional
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_discipline
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_audit_staff_rewarded } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_professional }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_discipline_campaign_rewarded } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_discipline }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_court_review_rewarded has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_executive_service_rewarded } } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_patronage }
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_social
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_social_republican
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_service_settlement_rewarded } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_social_republican }
	else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_social }
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_technical
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_ssr = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_technical }
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_regional_original
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_regional_managed
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_regional_aftercare
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_transition_settlement_rewarded } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_regional_aftercare }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_UKR_regional_standards_rewarded } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_regional_managed }
	else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_regional_original }
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_unconverted_orders
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_independent = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_deepen_specialisation_rewarded NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_export_conversion_rewarded has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_domestic_chains_rewarded } } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_UKR_unconverted_orders }
}

COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_check_status = {
	if = { limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_scenario_identity } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_scenario_identity
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_ever_ssr
		COLDWAR_SSR_load_tree = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_ssr = yes } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_ever_ssr }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_participant = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_ever_ssr is_subject = no has_capitulated = no NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_transition_recorded } }
		COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_capture_transition = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_transition_recorded
		COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_independent = yes COLDWAR_SSR_negotiated_transition_active = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_negotiated_cache } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_negotiated_cache
		COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_independent = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_SSR_negotiated_transition_active = yes } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_negotiated_cache }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_negotiated_cache
		COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_participant = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_party_cache_initialized } } COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_cache_party = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_ruling_party_slot value = ruling_party compare = not_equals } } COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_cache_party = yes COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes }
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_ssr = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_ssr_active } } COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes }
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_independent = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_independent_active } } COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_ssr = yes } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_ssr_active } COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_SSR_is_independent = yes } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SSR_lifecycle_independent_active } COLDWAR_SSR_reconcile = yes }
	}
}
